title: The Three Little Pigs and the Somewhat Bad Wolf
author: Mark Teague
intro: Three little pigs live on a farm. One day, the farmer pays them for their good work and moves away.
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: Where do the three little pigs live at the start of the story?
questions.clue: They work for a farmer and his wife.
questions.yes: The three little pigs live and work on a farm.

questions.q: Why do the three little pigs have to leave the farm?

options.text: The big red barn roof falls down

questions.clue: The farmer and his wife sell the farm and move somewhere sunny.
questions.yes: The farmer and his wife sell the farm and move to Florida.

questions.q: What does the farmer give the pigs before they leave?
questions.clue: They use it to buy things at the shops.
questions.yes: The farmer pays the pigs money for their good work.

questions.q: What does the first pig build his house out of?
questions.clue: It is cheap dry grass from the farm.
questions.yes: The first pig builds his house out of straw.

questions.q: Why does the first pig use cheap straw for his house?

options.text: To have money for potato chips
To save money for a car
To buy a new television set

questions.clue: He wants money left over to buy his favourite crunchy snack.
questions.yes: He uses cheap straw so he can buy lots of potato chips.

questions.q: What does the second pig buy after building a house of sticks?
questions.clue: It is a fizzy drink in bottles.
questions.yes: The second pig spends the rest of his money on sody-pop.

questions.q: What does the third pig spend her money on?
questions.clue: She buys strong building supplies for her house.
questions.yes: The third pig buys bricks and mortar to build a strong house.

questions.q: How does the wolf feel when he cannot get food in town?
questions.clue: He is very hungry and cannot get anything to eat in town.
questions.yes: The hungry wolf is angry when he cannot get food in town.

questions.q: What does the wolf do to the straw house and the stick house?

options.text: He huffs and blows them down
He climbs up onto their roofs
He paints their front doors red

questions.clue: He takes a deep breath and uses wind power from his mouth.
questions.yes: The wolf huffs and puffs and blows the first two houses down.

questions.q: Where do the first two pigs run for safety?

options.text: Back to the old farmer's barn
Into a big hollow tree trunk

questions.clue: They go to the only strong house left.
questions.yes: The two brothers run to their sister's strong brick house.

questions.q: What happens when the wolf tries to blow down the brick house?
questions.clue: All that huffing and puffing while hungry makes him pass out.
questions.yes: The hungry wolf runs out of breath and faints.

questions.q: What do the first two pigs give the wolf when he wakes up?
questions.clue: They share the snacks and fizzy drinks they bought earlier.
questions.yes: The first two pigs give the wolf potato chips and sody-pop.

questions.q: How does the wolf feel about his bad behaviour once he is fed?
questions.clue: He feels shy and sorry for acting grumpy when he was hungry.
questions.yes: The wolf feels embarrassed about how he acted when he was hungry.

questions.q: Who cooks a healthy meal for everyone?
questions.clue: She is the sensible sister who built the brick house and garden.
questions.yes: The third pig makes everyone a healthy meal.

questions.q: Where do all three pigs and the wolf live at the end?
questions.clue: Only one pig has a house left, so everyone moves in with her.
questions.yes: The other two pigs and the wolf move into the brick house.
